blocks.text: MARAMAG, Bukidnon — More than 65 percent of some 1,500 hectares of sugarcane fields infested by the red-striped soft scale insect (RSSI) in Bukidnon have been treated, as authorities race to save crops before the 2026–2027 sugar milling season opens in November. The Bukidnon Provincial Task Force, led by Gov. Rogelio Neil Roque and Quezon Mayor Pablo Lorenzo III—is using biological control agents and targeted chemicals across six affected areas: Dangcagan, Don Carlos, Kitaotao, Maramag, Quezon, and Valencia City. The pest was first detected in Barangay East Dalurong, Kitaotao, in June. Crystal Sugar Milling Co. Inc. (CSCI) deputy resident manager Kishler […]...
